title: Chapter Six: Housing — housing / moderate-income element of the 2020 Copperton General Plan
notes: Copperton's housing element is an EMBEDDED GENERAL-PLAN CHAPTER (Chapter Six: Housing, printed pp 103-109; sections 6.0-6.7 incl. a 'Cost-Burdened and Moderate-Income Housing' subsection + a Housing Work Program with goals/objectives/actions), NOT an HB462-era standalone Moderate Income Housing Plan. It cites the general-plan-components statute 10-9a-403 (housing for residents of various income levels) but does NOT reference HB 462 / SB 34 / the 10-9a-408 annual-reporting regime. SAME raw PDF as the general_plan row (do NOT double-count as two files). Copperton (~800 pop, MSD-staffed) files NO standalone HB462 MIH element and NO 10-9a-408 annual report, and is ABSENT from every state HCD compilation — see AVAILABILITY.md.
